result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [scorers.clear_cache()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: >- Clear the scores that Validate.col\_vals\_scored() keeps in memory. twitter-card: title: >- [scorers.clear_cache()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: >- Clear the scores that Validate.col\_vals\_scored() keeps in memory. title: >- [scorers.clear_cache()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: >- Clear the scores that Validate.col\_vals\_scored() keeps in memory. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Clear the scores that `Validate.col_vals_scored()` keeps in memory. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/scorers.py#L1601-L1636){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature scorers.clear_cache() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} With `cache=True` (the default of `~~pointblank.Validate.col_vals_scored()`), the scores of a scorer are kept in memory for the rest of the session, so that interrogating the same data again (as in an ablation, or after a change to another step) doesn't score it again. This clears them, for all the scorers. A cache on disk (`cache=` as a directory) isn't changed: delete its directory to clear it. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Nothing; the scores in memory are deleted. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} After this, the next interrogation of a scored step scores its rows again. ::: {#9981c28f .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb pb.scorers.clear_cache() ``` ::: This is useful when a scorer's model has changed without a change to its name or version.
